messages:
alex: Starting cross-cluster swap of lite-kernel v3b (quant-matmul-lite) in night window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: staged slices 5% -> 25% -> 100%. ABI shim 0.9 handshake required. Rollback criteria: 95p latency +10% or errors >0.5% sustained 10m. I'll kick off preflight in staging now. :wave:

deploy-bot: preflight checks running... configs validated (canary routes, weight-sets). No image checksum mismatch. ETA ~3m.

maria: can you add a one-liner for release notes? e.g., "lite-kernel v3b: optimized matmul path for quantized models; reduces token latency on short sequences". I'll draft.

kai: I'll watch telemetry (latency p50/p95, model dropouts, kv-cache hits). ping me if canary alarm fires. :eyes: 

sam: test plan reminder: run loadgen 1/5/25 qps slices, smoke at 5% for 15m. I'll update the canary job to run for 20m after 25% step.

jen: pre-pin older runtime on fallback pools? recommend pin runtime v2.9 on fallback ring for 2 hours post-cutover.

ops-oncall: schedule looks good. We'll reserve the quiet window and set extra pager thresholds. I'll put a temporary throttling rule in case of surge.

deploy-bot: preflight completed. Staging smoke passed: 0.02% errors, p95 delta +2%. Ready for canary slice.

alex: starting 5% canary now. command:
```
deploybot rollout --svc runtime-lite --image lite-kernel:v3b --slice 5
```

maria: quick heads-up: release-note draft: "lite-kernel v3b: matmul micro-optimizations for 8-bit quant, improves short-context latency; ABI shim 0.9 required." sending PR.

kai: canary metrics coming in: p95 +1.8%, error 0.04%, kv cache hits stable. No concerning GC spikes.

sam: advancing to 25% after 15m if metrics stable. I'll start the job at :clock1:.

deploy-bot: slice advanced to 25% (rolled out to cluster group A/B). Monitoring hooks enabled.

alex: reminder: rollback command if needed:
```
deploybot rollback --svc runtime-lite --to-image lite-kernel:v3a
```

jen: pinned v2.9 on fallback ring as discussed.

ops-oncall: set temporary rate-limit: 1.2x baseline for runtime-lite endpoints during rollouts.

kai: 25% stable at +2.3% p95, errors 0.06%. KV hit rate -0.3pp. All within thresholds.

maria: release-note PR linked: <https://git.internal/release-notes/123|lite-kernel-v3b>. please review.

sam: moving to 100% in 30m with staggered per-region migration. ops-oncall and kai on watch.

deploy-bot: final sweep: checksum ok, regional health checks green.

alex: cutover complete for EU/NA regions. APAC scheduled +10m to avoid peak.

kai: post-cutover telemetry: p95 +2.7%, errors 0.07%, no increase in model rejections. marking as healthy.

maria: posted release-note and short blurb to #announcements. :thumbsup: 

ops-oncall: removing temporary throttles; leaving pin on fallback ring for 2h.

jen: setting a 2h TTL pin; will auto-unpin at 2h unless extended.

sam: updating runbook: add note about ABI shim handshake; troubleshooting steps if kv-cache drop >2pp.

alex: thanks all. leaving this thread open for an hour for any late regressions. :rotating_light:

kai: ack. will escalate if anomaly > threshold.

deploy-bot: automated postrollout check in 30m.

alex: last checkin: zero rollbacks, roll was clean. closing in 1h unless flags.
